title: Claude Fable is relentlessly proactive
summary: Simon Willison explores Claude's new 'Fable' feature, which demonstrates aggressive proactive agentic behavior - autonomously taking initiative without waiting for explicit user prompts, representing a significant shift in how AI assistants interact with users.
problem_solved: Addresses the limitation of reactive AI assistants that only respond when explicitly prompted, instead enabling AI to autonomously drive tasks forward.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a paradigm shift toward truly autonomous AI agents that can proactively manage complex workflows, potentially transforming how humans interact with AI tools.
